candidate: C04 ELIXDB lichen library (GNPS ELIXDB-LICHEN-DATABASE; MetaboLights MTBLS8109; Bracegirdle et al., Sci Data 12:244, 2025, PMC11814408)
verdict_note: One MERGED stepped-collision-energy spectrum per compound (534 compounds, 534 mzXML files, no per-energy file anywhere in the deposit), so criterion 8 fails structurally and criterion 5 cannot be satisfied: the only energy statement is the constant string '10, 35, 80 eV' in the article and the ISA protocol, with no per-spectrum CE field and no way to tell absolute eV from normalized collision energy on the Orbitrap Exploris 120 from metadata. The positive-mode pool is small (96 [M+H]+ records, 93 keys) and after key exclusions leaves 72 keys in 24 MURU scaffold groups (16 keys / 13 groups once MURU scaffold groups are also excluded), too few for a scaffold-split calibration plus held-out evaluation. Criterion 11 is worse than 'plausible': one ELIXDB spectrum is verifiably already in MassSpecGym 1.5 under a GNPS-LIBRARY accession.
correction_to_candidate_sheet: The candidate sheet says 'individual-CE spectra said to be in MTBLS8109'. REFUTED: MTBLS8109 holds 534 mzXML files under FILES/, the same 534 names under RAW_FILES/ and under DERIVED_FILES/ (announcement file lists: derived_data_file_list 534 .mzXML, supplementary_file_list 1068 .mzXML, no .raw, no other extension). The article and the ISA Mass spectrometry protocol both say the deposited scan is the merged one.

criterion_notes.1: 3 of 518 keys are in the MURU V2 development population (1 of the 93 [M+H]+ keys); 10 of 518 in the full exposure registry (3 of 93). Removable by key. Scaffold-level is not: 92 of 518 keys (35 of 93 [M+H]+ keys) share a MURU development scaffold group.
criterion_notes.2: 0 of 518 keys in the PR #7 (MSnLib confirmation study 2) frozen population of 1,794; 28 keys share a PR #7 scaffold group (1 of the [M+H]+ keys).
criterion_notes.3: 0 of 518 keys and 0 scaffold groups in the comparator benchmark common population (1,327 keys / 1,254 groups).
criterion_notes.4: 86 of 518 keys are in MassSpecGym 1.5 (all folds, either the recorded inchikey or the MURU parent key); 21 of the 93 [M+H]+ keys. In the simulation-challenge subset that ICEBERG/GLACIER msg_simulation actually trains on: 17 of 518 (4 of 93). 631 MassSpecGym rows carry these keys (Orbitrap 479, QTOF 68, NA 84; [M+H]+ 430, [M+Na]+ 201; train 598 / test 19 / val 14).
criterion_notes.5: Only a constant per-sample string: ISA s_MTBLS8109.txt Comment[Collision energy] = '10, 35, 80' for all 534 samples, with no unit column; the ISA Mass spectrometry protocol and the article both read 'merged spectra were generated from a combination of individual collision events at 10, 35 and 80 eV'. The GNPS LibraryServlet record schema has no energy field at all (31 fields, none matching energy|collision). The MHD JSON repeats the same protocol text and adds nothing. Whether 10/35/80 are absolute eV or normalized collision energy on an Orbitrap Exploris 120 (which supports both) cannot be decided from any deposited metadata, and the merged spectrum has no single energy to map in any case.
criterion_notes.6: [M+H]+ present but a minority: 96 of 534 records (93 keys, 33 scaffold groups); 437 [M-H]-, 1 2M+H. Ion mode Positive 97 / Negative 437. All 96 [M+H]+ precursors fall inside MURU's development range 70.0-1042.6 m/z and all agree with the SMILES within 0.01 Da (the 6 precursor inconsistencies > 0.01 Da are all [M-H]- records).
criterion_notes.7: Instrument is compatible in kind: Thermo Orbitrap Exploris 120, HCD beam-type, ESI, positive rows map to the ms-pred token 'Orbitrap' (src/ms_pred/common/chem_utils.py:277-283 instrument2onehot_pos). Incompatible in acquisition: (a) the spectrum is a stepped/merged activation, which MURU's external protocol excludes and which has no fixed NCE 20/60 rung (src/muru/wur_v2/external_msnlib.py:23 RUNGS=(20.0,60.0)); (b) the MS2 scan window lower limit is 100 (ISA assay Parameter Value[Scan m/z range] = '100-1000' for all 534) or 140 (protocol text '140-2000 m/z', a disclosed internal contradiction), both above MURU's FIRST_MASS_MAX = 40.0 (external_msnlib.py:31) and above MultiMS2 R4_LOWER_MAX = 50.0 (external_multims2.py:36), so no ELIXDB spectrum would pass MURU's window rule; (c) ICEBERG/GLACIER need a scalar CE per prediction and skip nan energies (src/ms_pred/glacier/predict_smis_joint.py:180-183), while ms-pred represents merged spectra as collision energy 'nan' (src/ms_pred/common/misc_utils.py:1470, 2142).
criterion_notes.8: NOT_MET. 534 GNPS records over 534 distinct source files (max 1 record per file); MTBLS FILES/, RAW_FILES/ and DERIVED_FILES/ hold the identical 534 mzXML names (2.2-4.0 KB each) and the assay table lists 534 distinct Derived Spectral Data Files with an empty Raw Spectral Data File column. The three collision events exist only inside the single merged scan. Energies per compound available to a user: 1 (merged), not 3.
criterion_notes.9: [M+H]+ pool after key exclusion against MassSpecGym 1.5 (all folds), the MURU exposure registry, MURU development, PR #7 and the comparator population: 72 keys in 24 scaffold groups, 15 of them singletons, largest group 21 keys (xanthones), second 13, third 8. Excluding MURU/PR7/comparator scaffold groups as well leaves 16 keys / 13 groups; also excluding MassSpecGym scaffold groups leaves 11 keys / 9 groups. If only the ICEBERG/GLACIER training universe (simulation-challenge keys) is excluded, 88 keys / 33 groups. Chemistry is narrow by construction (depsides, depsidones, xanthones, dibenzofurans; elements C,H,O plus Cl in 25 of the 74 post-exclusion records, with no N and no S in that pool; the full 96-record [M+H]+ set adds exactly 1 N-containing record).
criterion_notes.10: Public and open. MetaboLights MTBLS8109 PUBLIC, submitted 2023-06-30, released 2024-10-09, revision 2 on 2025-09-08 ('updating data license'); announcement/MHD license field = https://www.ebi.ac.uk/about/terms-of-use/. GNPS library ELIXDB-LICHEN-DATABASE is publicly browsable (534 records, created 2024-08-14 09:17:24). Article is CC BY 4.0. Study size 48.21 MiB, all of it mzXML, so a spectra-level use would be a small download once a study authorizes it.
criterion_notes.11: The library as such is NOT in MassSpecGym: notebook 1 cell 1 of pluskal-lab/MassSpecGym at 1a54459 lists the 46 GNPS libraries downloaded on 13/05/2024, ELIXDB is not among them and the GNPS library was created 2024-08-14; MassSpecGym 1.5 changed only the SMILES column relative to 1.0. But hidden inclusion under a different identifier is not merely plausible, it is demonstrated for one spectrum: GNPS-LIBRARY accession CCMSLIB00011427585 ('3beta-Acetoxyfern-9(11)-ene-12-one', PI Chooi, collector J Bracegirdle, Orbitrap, M+H, precursor 483.383, source file 'f.joebracegirdle/3 Scan[4644].mzXML', created 2023-05-21) is the same compound, same precursor and same '<n> Scan' file naming as ELIXDB record CCMSLIB00012718462 (source file '3 Scan.mzXML'), and it appears in MassSpecGym 1.5 as MassSpecGymID0398009 (precursor_mz 483.383 exactly, 3 decimals, Orbitrap, [M+H]+, fold train, collision_energy NaN, simulation_challenge False, identifier 398009 which lies in the GNPS-first identifier region). GNPS-LIBRARY is one of the 46 loaded libraries. Second route: MassSpecGym did load LDB_POSITIVE and LDB_NEGATIVE (the 2019 lichen database); 126 of the 518 ELIXDB keys (26 of the 93 [M+H]+ keys) are LDB compounds, and 146 of the 251 LDB keys are in MassSpecGym 1.5 (18 in the simulation-challenge subset). So the lichen chemistry of this candidate is partly inside the ICEBERG/GLACIER training corpus already.

if_reconsidered: Only a new acquisition would help: the individual 10/35/80 activations are not deposited in any form (no Thermo .raw in MTBLS8109), so even author contact would be a request for data that may no longer exist, and the unit question (absolute eV vs NCE) would still have to be answered from the original instrument method file.
no_spectra_statement: No mzXML, mzML, MGF, MSP, raw, HDF5 or any other peak-bearing file was downloaded or read. GNPS LibraryServlet responses were checked record by record for non-null peaks_json before storing (0 non-null in ELIXDB-LICHEN-DATABASE 534, GNPS-LIBRARY 16,158, LDB_POSITIVE 700, LDB_NEGATIVE 580). The MetaboLights MHD JSON was checked for peak-array keys before storing. No ICEBERG, GLACIER, FIORA or MURU prediction was run; no MURU measured-mu, result, prediction or analysis file was opened.
